title: feat: add accurate Quest leaderboard to Community
author: MetaMysteries8
pr_body_excerpt:
Closes #13909

## What

Adds a compact Quest leaderboard to `/community`, backed only by the existing reward ledger.

- Public `GET /api/quests/leaderboard` aggregate for rewards whose `questId` matches `github:issue:*`
- Ranks contributors by total Quest Pollen, then completed quest count, then GitHub login for deterministic ties
- Exposes only public GitHub login, completed quest count, and total Quest Pollen
- Computes global totals across every matching contributor before applying the top-50 presentation cap
- Community contributor section shows a compact top-8 Quest leaderboard plus aggregate totals and a link to the current Quests page
- Focused tests cover quest-only/privacy filtering, the >50-contributor aggregate case, and server-rendered leaderboard output

No Tinybird, new tables, live GitHub scraping, seasons, badges, or general leaderboard framework.

## Validation

Test coverage is included for the aggregate and rendered leaderboard. I have not manually claimed local test execution here; CI should verify the branch in the repository environment.

## AI assistance disclosure

ChatGPT assisted through my connected GitHub account with repository inspection, implementation design, code preparation, and the GitHub operations used to create this branch and PR. I requested this assistance and am intentionally disclosing it rather than presenting the work as fully manual.

gist.headline: The quest garden has rankings
gist.blurb: Quest Pollen now leaves a little trail through the community garden. The Community page has a compact leaderboard for the people turning useful contributions into flowers.
gist.summary: Added a public GET /api/quests/leaderboard endpoint backed by the existing reward ledger, plus a top-8 Quest leaderboard on /community that ranks GitHub contributors by total Quest Pollen, completed quests, and login while calculating aggregate totals across all contributors.
gist.impact: Community visitors can now see the leading Quest contributors, total completed quests, and total Quest Pollen at a glance, with only public GitHub logins and quest-specific reward data exposed.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Community page as a cozy garden leaderboard: a small wooden ranking board with eight glowing Pollen jars and GitHub-style name plaques, surrounded by blooming code-plants. Polli should be proudly pinning a tiny quest medal onto the board while the eager CRT Monitor Robot counts Pollen totals; the scene makes the leaderboard feel like a public garden of useful contributions rather than a competitive arena.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
